description: Agent Accountability: submit a payments activity report or metrics definition: each headline number with what it measures (transaction count, settled value, payer count, average ticket), its value, how it is computed and what it excludes. The signed report says whether settled value is separated from transaction churn, whether self-payments and test payments are excluded, whether payers are counted as distinct wallets paying with their own money, and every headline number that can rise with no commerce behind it. A metrics summary’s ticket sizes are wever_settled-value-check. Verdict inflatable, quality_unverified or commerce_backed. POST /api/volume-quality-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-accountability-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-accountability/.
